tokens.name: ha-surface-base
tokens.usage: Page background behind the content column and the sidebar.

tokens.name: ha-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tables, cards, panels, form fields, the navbar: anything that holds data.

tokens.name: ha-surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header row, code wells, the stripe behind a filter bar, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: ha-surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, menus, toasts and popovers; always paired with ha-shadow-lg.

tokens.name: ha-surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row hover and nav-item hover fill; never the only signal of state.

tokens.name: ha-surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected and bulk-selected table rows; pair with a checked checkbox.

tokens.name: ha-color-border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table row dividers, card edges, section rules. Decorative, not a control edge.

tokens.name: ha-color-border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons), 3:1 or better on every surface they sit on: light 3.43:1 on surface-base, 3.62:1 on surface-raised and overlay, 3.22:1 on surface-sunken; dark 3.90:1 on surface-base, 3.62:1 on surface-raised, 3.23:1 on surface-overlay.

tokens.name: ha-color-text-strong
tokens.usage: Headings, table cell values that are the record's title, the money total. 17.6:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ha-color-text
tokens.usage: Body copy and ordinary cell values, on base, raised and sunken: 7.14:1 on surface-base (light), 11.76:1 on surface-raised (dark).

tokens.name: ha-color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Help text, metadata, column headers, null values. Tuned from the brief's #677489 (4.49:1 on surface-base fails AA) to 5.20:1 on surface-base, 4.88:1 on surface-sunken; dark 6.90:1 on surface-raised, 6.15:1 on surface-overlay.

tokens.name: ha-color-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only; WCAG exempts inactive controls. Never for information.

tokens.name: ha-color-brand
tokens.usage: The HyperAdmin teal: logo tile, focus ring, the active-nav indicator bar, chart-1. Not a text colour on white (3.74:1) and not a fill under white text.

tokens.name: ha-color-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, checked checkbox, active pagination page, selected tab underline. Light moved one step darker than the brief's #0D9488 so white labels pass (5.47:1).

tokens.name: ha-color-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and pressed fill.

tokens.name: ha-color-on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on ha-color-primary: 5.47:1 light, 10.06:1 dark.

tokens.name: ha-color-primary-text
tokens.usage: Links, active nav label, sortable header in use, relation links in cells. 5.19:1 on surface-base, 5.25:1 on primary-soft; dark 11.77:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ha-color-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind primary-text: active nav item, applied filter chips, info about the current tenant.

tokens.name: ha-color-accent
tokens.usage: The 'hyper' violet. Rare: one accent CTA per screen, a 'New' tag, the live presence ring. 5.94:1 on white; dark 7.98:1 on surface-raised. Never for a destructive or error meaning.

tokens.name: ha-color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill: 5.94:1 light, 8.58:1 dark.

tokens.name: ha-color-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text (the 'New' tag); accent on it 5.18:1 light, 6.66:1 dark.

tokens.name: ha-color-danger
tokens.usage: Danger button fill and destructive marks (delete-marked row edge). White on it 4.83:1; dark uses ha-color-on-danger (6.72:1).

tokens.name: ha-color-on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on ha-color-danger.

tokens.name: ha-color-danger-text
tokens.usage: Error messages, invalid field text, the 'Failed' pill word. 5.10:1 on danger-soft, 5.54:1 on white (brief's #D92D20 was 4.44:1 on its tint); dark 8.97:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ha-color-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error alert and danger pill background; invalid field fill stays raised.

tokens.name: ha-color-success-text
tokens.usage: Success messages, 'Paid' pill word. 5.40:1 on success-soft; dark 9.11:1.

tokens.name: ha-color-success-soft
tokens.usage: Success alert and pill background.

tokens.name: ha-color-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning messages, 'Overdue' pill word. 5.20:1 on warning-soft; dark 9.30:1.

tokens.name: ha-color-warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning alert and pill background.

tokens.name: ha-color-info-text
tokens.usage: Info messages, 'Draft' pill word, the reconnecting state. 5.49:1 on info-soft; dark 9.22:1.

tokens.name: ha-color-info-soft
tokens.usage: Info alert and pill background.

tokens.name: ha-color-focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element: 3.74:1 on raised, 3.55:1 on base, 3.33:1 on sunken; dark 8.3:1 or better.

tokens.name: ha-color-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the mobile nav drawer.

tokens.name: ha-chart-1
tokens.usage: First series (teal, same as ha-color-brand). 3.74:1 on raised (light), 9.35:1 (dark): enough for marks, not for text, so direct labels for this series use ha-color-primary-text.

tokens.name: ha-chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series (deep violet). Series alternate lighter and darker so neighbours always differ in lightness (1.5:1 or more between neighbours in both themes). 8.90:1 / 5.99:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ha-chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series (amber). 4.16:1 / 9.46:1.

tokens.name: ha-chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series (navy). 8.32:1 / 5.35:1.

tokens.name: ha-chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth series (magenta), the lighter step after navy. 4.02:1 / 9.60:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ha-chart-6
tokens.usage: Sixth series and 'Other' (slate), the darker step after magenta. 7.69:1 / 5.52:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ha-chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines only: deliberately faint, never carries data.

tokens.name: ha-chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis lines, tick labels and the zero line: same as text-muted, so tick labels pass 4.5:1.

families.sans: Inter, "Noto Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Hebrew", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Thai", "Noto Sans SC", "Noto Sans JP", "Noto Sans KR", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: ha-display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the stat that the dashboard is for, the login heading.

styles.name: ha-h1
styles.usage: Page title in the page header.

styles.name: ha-h2
styles.usage: Detail summary header, dialog-free section titles.

styles.name: ha-h3
styles.usage: Panel and fieldset titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: ha-body-lg
styles.sample: Add an admin to an existing FastAPI app in ten minutes.
styles.usage: Empty-state and login copy; touch layouts under 768px.

styles.name: ha-body
styles.usage: Default for forms, tables, alerts. 1.5 line height keeps Thai and Devanagari marks clear.

styles.name: ha-body-strong
styles.usage: Record titles in a row, field labels, button labels.

styles.name: ha-label
styles.usage: Field labels in compact density, table column headers, filter chips.

styles.name: ha-caption
styles.usage: Help text, timestamps, pill text, sidebar group headings. Smallest size allowed.

styles.name: ha-mono
styles.usage: IDs, UUID and string keys, API keys, ISO timestamps. Always dir=ltr.

styles.name: ha-mono-sm
styles.usage: Secondary IDs inside a cell, audit-log timestamps.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Component padding uses these steps; density swaps row and control heights in the size family, not the spacing steps.

tokens.name: ha-space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudge, pill vertical padding.

tokens.name: ha-space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label inside a pill; checkbox-to-label in compact.

tokens.name: ha-space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and a button label; cell padding-inline in compact; chip gap.

tokens.name: ha-space-3
tokens.usage: Cell padding-inline (comfortable); control padding-inline; gap between stacked fields in compact.

tokens.name: ha-space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding (compact); gap between form fields; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: ha-space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a page header and its toolbar.

tokens.name: ha-space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding (comfortable); gap between panels; desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: ha-space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; dialog padding.

tokens.name: ha-space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding; login card padding.

tokens.name: ha-space-16
tokens.usage: Error page top offset.

tokens.name: ha-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, pills' inner badge, table cells being edited, tooltip.

tokens.name: ha-radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, chips, nav items. The logo tile is this radius at its 24px size.

tokens.name: ha-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the table container, alerts, toasts.

tokens.name: ha-radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the login card only.

tokens.name: ha-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, avatars, the live dot, count badges.

tokens.name: ha-shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and the table container on surface-base; mostly the border does the work.

tokens.name: ha-shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, the sticky table header once scrolled, dropdown filters.

tokens.name: ha-shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, toasts and the mobile nav drawer.

size.note: Heights, widths and targets. Comfortable is the default; [data-density=compact] on <html> or any container switches the -compact values in.

tokens.name: ha-row-height
tokens.usage: Table row, comfortable density; also the 44px touch target.

tokens.name: ha-row-height-compact
tokens.usage: Table row, compact density (desktop pointers only).

tokens.name: ha-control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, comfortable.

tokens.name: ha-control-height-compact
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, compact. Still above the 24px target minimum.

tokens.name: ha-target-min
tokens.usage: WCAG 2.2 minimum hit area for icon buttons, checkboxes and sort toggles.

tokens.name: ha-target-touch
tokens.usage: Hit area under (pointer: coarse).

tokens.name: ha-icon-size
tokens.usage: Lucide outline icons, 1.5px stroke; 16px inside pills and compact buttons.

tokens.name: ha-navbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: ha-sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Expanded sidebar.

tokens.name: ha-sidebar-width-collapsed
tokens.usage: Collapsed sidebar: icons and the mark only.

tokens.name: ha-content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content column; tables may opt out and run full width.

tokens.name: ha-bp-md
tokens.usage: Below: table becomes cards, sidebar becomes a drawer, charts may fall back to stat or table.

tokens.name: ha-bp-lg
tokens.usage: Below: sidebar starts collapsed.

tokens.name: ha-bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop-first design target (1280–1920).

tokens.name: ha-z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table header and first column.

tokens.name: ha-z-nav
tokens.usage: Navbar and sidebar.

tokens.name: ha-z-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialog and drawer, with its scrim.

tokens.name: ha-z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast stack; above dialogs so a conflict toast is visible.
